description: This file implements the Request class for WebSockets JSON-RPC communication, including methods for creating requests, generating IDs, and converting requests to string format.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC request message with methods to create and serialize the request, and manage request IDs.

methods.name: Request::create
methods.description: Creates a JSON-RPC request with specified method and parameters, validating version and method.

methods.name: Request::getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the request.

methods.name: Request::toString
methods.description: Serializes the request object to a JSON string.
